dataBehavior: Preserve independent source query keys, enabled vehicle guard, AbortSignal and inherited historical policy (5m stale, 30m gc, no ambient polling/focus/reconnect/mount refetch; retry remains ambient unless explicitly supplied).
Preserve null report versus successful empty arrays versus genuine measured zero. asList accepts Go null slices; do not turn unknown coefficients/energy/pressure/holdout into zero.
Keep raw Wh/m/kPa/Celsius/seconds/ohms data in source/cache. Current rest_hours, precipitation mm and specialist units are actual contracts, not permission to guess replacements.
Temperature spans and residuals are differences: use formatTemperatureDelta; absolute Celsius uses formatTemperature.
Preserve signed correlations and slopes; no health percentage, diagnostic certainty, invented confidence score or causality claim.
Keep honesty, firmware epoch, truncated/sample-cap notice, fit eligibility, confidence and holdout explanations, missing-signals disclosures and generated record identities.
A tire sensitivity band is not a confidence interval; assumed placard/reference capacity is not measured capacity.
Charts sample up to 400 supplied points without rewriting source arrays; tables retain supplied observations, stable identities and source scope.

Source envelope carries additional signals_used, pooled_epochs, interval and diagnostic fields not all rendered by current page. Their existence is not evidence of a visible action or authorization to delete payload fields.
Backend fit correctness, weather joins, end-bound inclusivity, maximum window acceptance and extra_model_low/high units require independent backend evidence.
